description: Log a new DEFECT in the connected project — what Defect Management → Create Defect does — and return its key (DE-xx). Only `name` is required; state and priority default to the project's own default values, and the answer lists what was defaulted. Optional: `description`, `severity`, `category` (the project's own values; an unknown one is refused with the valid ones listed), `assignee` (email, name, user id or "me"), `releaseId` / `sprintId` (id, code or name), `storyId` (the USER STORY field: id or key, e.g. US-25), `testCases` (the TEST CASE field: "TC-41" or "TC-41:v1.0" — the test case then lists the defect, checked after saving), `module` (default: the project's Default module), `estimatedEffort`, `customFields` ({ key: value } — needed when the project marks custom fields mandatory), and the rest of the form: `environment`, `executionType` (alias `type`: Manual / Automation), `featureId`, `plannedStartDate` / `plannedEndDate` (YYYY-MM-DD), `linkages` ([{ destType, destId, linkType }], saved from the defect's side) and `attachments` ([{ filePath }]). Environment / Type are checked against the project's own list (or the form's: Development / QA / UAT, Manual / Automation); a bad value refuses the call before anything is created. A defect with the same name is refused. Reads the defect back. Needs the add_defect privilege. To log a defect FROM a failed execution step (evidence pre-filled), use defect_create_from_step instead; to change one later, defect_update.

assignee.description: Email, name, numeric user id or "me". Default: unassigned.

attachments.description: ATTACHMENTS: files to attach to the defect (max 20 MB each). To remove or download one later: attachment_delete / attachment_download with entityType "defect".

base64.description: File content as base64 when there is no local path. Requires fileName.

contentType.description: MIME type; inferred from the extension when omitted.

fileName.description: Name to store it under (default: the file's own name).

filePath.description: Absolute path of the file (read on this machine).

environment.description: ENVIRONMENT: one of the project's own list, or the form's (Development, QA, UAT). An unknown value is refused with the valid ones.

executionType.description: TYPE (the form's Execution Type): Manual or Automation (or the project's own list).

featureId.description: FEATURE: a feature of this project — id, business key (FT-248) or exact name.

linkages.description: LINKAGES, saved from the DEFECT's side (the form's Linkages section). A link that already exists is left as it is.

destId.description: Its id or business key (US-25, DE-9, FT-248, TA-4).

destType.description: What the defect is linked TO.

linkType.description: The link type as the Linkages dropdown shows it ("Clones", "Relates to", …). An unknown one is refused with the available ones.

module.description: Module name, code or id. Default: the project's Default module.

plannedEndDate.description: PLANNED END DATE, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

releaseId.description: Release: id, code (RE-44) or exact name.

sprintId.description: Sprint: id, code (SP-1) or exact name; it must belong to the release.

storyId.description: USER STORY field: story id or key (US-25).

type.description: Same as executionType — the form's TYPE field.

name: defect_create
title: Log a defect (create)
